entries.aa6b0bca1134e9dd: It adopts 'Sincerity (INTEGRITY)' as its corporate motto and, under its corporate philosophy formulated in 2024, aims to be 'a company that creates culture from interiors, starting from materials and design.' To achieve its long-term vision 'DESIGN 2030', the Medium-Term Management Plan 2029 (fiscal years from the one ending March 2027 through the one ending March 2030) sets as its basic policies strengthening the interior business, developing the comprehensive space business and exterior business, growing overseas operations, and exploring and creating next-generation businesses, and aims for consolidated net sales of ¥250 billion for the fiscal year ended March 2030.
